messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — Zenith sent over an RFI + questionnaire about POC and enterprise capabilities. Major asks: on‑prem HSM support, FedRAMP/compliance posture, Dedicated capacity sizing, per‑token pricing bands for hosted vs dedicated, and acceptance criteria for a POC. They attached a capability matrix and want written answers + attachments by EOD Wed. @samuel @nora can you take point on tech/security?

samuel (SE): Thanks — uploaded a quick read of the matrix. Couple clarifying Qs for Zenith before we answer: 1) target tokens/sec and avg seq len? 2) model families they want validated (Llamax, Mistral, open-weights)? 3) are they expecting streaming / tool-calling in POC?

maria (AE): Notes from the customer call: they plan two flows — interactive chat (avg 512 tokens, bursty: 60qps) and batch embedding jobs (20k vectors overnight). They flagged on‑prem HSM for key custody and a legal requirement for data residency in EU. Streaming yes for chat.

devon (SRE): For 60 qps interactive with 512 tokens typical, recommended Dedicated config is 4xA10G equiv or 2xA100p for consistent latency at 99th percentile under concurrent sessions. For batch embeddings we can schedule nightly workers and save cost. Also note warmup/kv cache prefill reduces cold P99 spikes.

nora (Security): On the sec questionnaire — key items: KMS + HSM integration, audit logging retention, ringfenced network (VPC peering or private link), SOC2/FedRAMP status + evidence. We have a standard HSM answer but need customer’s HSM vendor/requirements (PKCS#11, KMIP?). Ask them to confirm. I’ll draft the security section.

ellie (Sales Eng): I can take the capability matrix writeup. Plan: 1) fill feature rows (HSM, on‑prem, model catalog, streaming, quantization), 2) attach a short runbook + POC plan PDF, 3) include a sample SOW and success criteria. I’ll drop a draft in the thread by tomorrow morning.

samuel (SE): POC plan I recommend: Week0: infra prep + security signoff; Week1: ingest sample dataset + baseline hosted run; Week2: deploy Dedicated/private agent + perf tuning; Week3: acceptance + handoff. Acceptance criteria examples: sustained 50qps @ <1500ms p95 for chat, embedding throughput >= X vectors/hour, and quality parity on a 50-prompt eval set.

maria (AE): Pricing ask — they want both a hosted per‑token quote and a committed Dedicated monthly band with burst allowance. Can finance provide guidance on committed tiers and overage rates? Also need a rough estimate for the POC (3 weeks — infra + SE time).

ellie (Sales Eng): For POC estimate I usually include: 2 SEs (20h each/week), 1 SRE (10h/week), Dedicated infra credits for testing (estimate ~ $6k in GPU runtime), plus docs/legal review. I’ll put a line-itemized estimate in the doc.

devon (SRE): One gotcha: if they require on‑prem HSM + air‑gapped, we need longer lead time for the appliance and validation (2–4 weeks). Call this out in the timeline so legal/security don’t get surprised.

nora (Security): Also requesting evidence: sample SOC2 report + pen test summary. I can attach redacted certs. For FedRAMP they’re asking if we operate in a FedRAMP environment — we currently don’t host FedRAMP, but we can outline the dedicated/private deployment controls and recommend a partner path.

samuel (SE): Tech attachment: dropping a short config snippet for how we map customer KMS to Redwood Private (example):
```
redwood_private:
  kms_provider: "customer_hsm"
  hsm_interface: "pkcs11"
  key_alias: "zenith-poc-key"
  network: "vpc-peering"
```

maria (AE): Perfect. Action items: @ellie build capability matrix + draft written answers; @nora draft security questionnaire responses + attach certs; @samuel prepare the POC SOW and perf targets; @devon add infra lead times and dedicated config notes. I’ll coordinate with the buyer for confirmation of HSM vendor and token targets.

ellie (Sales Eng): Will do. I’ll ping legal for SOW clause template and attach a sample by tomorrow.

nora (Security): Uploading redacted SOC2 + pen test summary to the RFI folder now: <https://rwd.internal/zenith-rfi>.

devon (SRE): FYI I opened a quick internal ticket for Dedicated capacity availability for the tentative POC dates: INC-7892. @samuel can we link the perf tests we usually run?

samuel (SE): Linking standard perf harness: <https://rwd.tools/perf-harness> — we’ll use the 512-token profile.

maria (AE): Great. Let’s aim to send the full RFI packet by Wed EOD. If anything blocks replies, flag it here. :thumbsup:

ellie (Sales Eng): Draft uploaded: sources/internal/zenith/zenith-capability-matrix-draft.pdf — requesting reviews from @samuel and @nora before I finalize. :wave:
